card.name: Scattered label phrases before a known continuation
card.fires_on: Single words inside fixed label phrases, such as 'too small' in the suicide-trial sentence or the company name 'Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc.' It also fires on the start of a brand name after 'treated with'.

modes.label: Too small to conclude
modes.description: The word 'small' in the stock sentence about too few suicide events to draw a conclusion.
modes.example: but the number of events is too<< small>> to allow any conclusion about drug effect on

modes.label: Manufacturer lines
modes.description: Words in company names and addresses in the 'Manufactured for' line.
modes.example: Made in Italy Manufactured for: Teva Pharmaceuticals USA<<,>> Inc. Parsippany, NJ

modes.label: Start of drug brand name
modes.description: The first letters of a drug name after 'treated with' or 'discontinue'.
modes.example: The proportion of subjects treated with<< V>>ELSIPITY who experienced lymphocyte counts
